Paychex Flex Time Essentials: Employee Time Tracking & Attendance Software

Paychex Flex Time Essentials helps businesses streamline employee time tracking, attendance management, and payroll preparation on one easy-to-use platform. In this video, you'll learn how employees can clock in using web punch, mobile devices, online timesheets, or facial recognition kiosks while employers gain powerful workforce management tools, including geolocation tracking, geofencing, labor reporting, job costing, timecard approvals, and payroll adjustments. Fully integrated with Paychex Flex®, Time Essentials simplifies workforce management, improves payroll accuracy, and helps employers make more informed labor decisions.

Topics:

  • 0:00 – Paychex Flex Time Essentials Overview
  • 0:10 – Employee Time Collection Methods
  • 0:39 – Payroll Adjustments and Timecard Approvals
  • 0:52 – Geolocation and Geofencing Tracking
  • 1:03 – Job Costing and Labor Reporting

<p id="transcript-button">View Transcript</p>

Paychex Flex Time Essentials Overview

0:02 Paychex Flex Time Essentials is designed to save you time and help prevent costly errors when time and attendance is tracked manually.

Employee Time Collection Methods

0:12 Fully integrated with our Paychex Flex platform, Paychex Flex Time Essentials provides you with many methods for time collection. Your employees can record their time through web punching, mobile app, online timesheets, or use your own tablets with our facial recognition kiosk app. Within our Paychex Flex Time Essentials solution, you can verify your employees’ arrival times and easily track their meal or rest breaks.

Payroll Adjustments and Timecard Approvals

0:41 Make pay adjustments for tips and other reimbursements, and approve time cards all in one easy to use system.

0:50 And we know that time and attendance goes beyond just tracking time.

Geolocation and Geofencing Tracking

0:54 That's why we offer you a range of reporting and tracking tools, including geolocation and geofencing, which allow you to see where your employees are clocking in.

Job Costing and Labor Reporting

1:05 Our job costing, labor distribution, and report scheduling can help you make better business decisions.

1:13 Paychex Flex Time Essentials gives you one seamless experience and helps make time and attendance simple.

Simplify Employee Time Tracking and Attendance

Manage employee time collection, attendance, payroll preparation, geofencing, and workforce reporting from one integrated platform.

Explore Paychex Flex Time Essentials
